title: Ravens say they've made "market-setting" offer to Tyler Linderbaum

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Ravens say they've made "market-setting" offer to Tyler Linderbaum
sources.description: Ravens General Manager Eric DeCosta said recently that the team had some work to do when it comes to re-signing center Tyler Linderbaum ahead of free agency and he revealed one of the steps they've taken during a Tuesday press conference in Indianapolis.
